fee_notes: Single Initial Franchise Fee of $19,950; 15% veteran discount reduces to $16,958. Separate Initial Territory Fee of $40,000 also due at signing (veteran discount to $34,000). Combined first-territory payment to franchisor is $59,950. No franchise fee on subsequent agreements. Conversion discount on territory fee: 10% of prior-year GR, max $10,000 off.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $19,950 when you sign the franchise agreement for your first territory.
